title: Setup → Datasources: the default datasource reads "connected" while its Test and Sync answer that no driver is registered
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-21** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Datasources.
- **Actual:** card "default · sqlite · connected"; Test → 200 + toast "default: [ObjectQL] Datasource 'default' has no registered driver to introspect."; Sync objects → `400 GET /api/v1/datasources/default/remote-tables`, then a dialog "No remote tables found on this datasource." A runtime `:memory:` datasource tests fine ("connection ok (0ms)"), and Setup has no edit or delete for it.
- **Evidence:** [`38-integrations-datasources-test.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/38-integrations-datasources-test.png), [`38-integrations-datasources-sync-objects.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/38-integrations-datasources-sync-objects.png), [`38-integrations-datasources-created.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/38-integrations-datasources-created.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** every deployment.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `service-datasource` (default datasource not registered for introspection) and console datasource page.
- **Dedupe words:** no registered driver to introspect, remote-tables 400, datasource delete missing.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `service-datasource`.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 15 hits in objectstack, 2 in objectui. The nearest is objectstack#24664 (`remote-tables?schema=`), a different defect. **New.**
